stage_c.objective: Minimize study-macro MAE among weights with pooled inner R2 within 0.015 of maximum; exact ties to B50 then smaller optimized weight. Training-only, nested optimized-procedure selection; never use outer labels.
stage_c.budget_policy: Calculate full upper bound before any fit; skip if over 100. Do not reduce nesting or candidate registry to fit budget.

diagnostics_only.prior_harmed_studies: Existing optimization paired per-study table: delta_MAE > 0.10; never used to set weights or gate.

stop: After mandatory outputs and final report; no new phase
